main.company_name: chart-combo, chart-form, kpi:bodies, insight:multi, insight:quality, table:multi, table:quality — licensed bodies are commercial entities (companies, partnerships, cooperatives, sole traders), named only in the multi-licence table; legal form is parsed from the name suffix
main.type: chart-chain, chart-rate, kpi:active, kpi:frozen, kpi:share, insight:frozen — code 10 marks a frozen/cancelled licence (fallback when the description is empty); other codes are grouped by their description
main.type_description: chart-chain, chart-rate, chart-labs, chart-other, kpi:active, kpi:frozen, insight:lead, insight:other, insight:rate — classified into supply-chain stages by keyword; frozen/cancelled detected by its wording
main.notes: chart-chain, chart-rate, chart-labs, chart-other, insight:labs, insight:other, insight:rate — for frozen rows the former activity (after the badge markup), for labs the service scope (research / GAP / GMP), for 'other' licences the sub-activity
